status: Prepared only; no Cloudflare settings or DNS records have been changed by this workspace.

manual_review.ssl: Prefer Full (strict) for customer-proxied hosts after checking each origin certificate. Sites custom-domain TLS is managed by the hosting provider.
manual_review.min_tls_version: Prefer TLS 1.2 or higher for modern website visitors; preserve any existing stronger policy and review other zone hosts first.
manual_review.always_use_https: Enable after all affected hostnames have working HTTPS; check existing redirect rules for loops.
manual_review.dnssec: Verify registrar and authoritative DNS state together before enabling or changing DS records.
manual_review.hsts: Only after HTTPS is stable. Do not enable includeSubDomains or preload until every relevant host is audited.
manual_review.email: Preserve MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, mail-host records and any email-routing settings. Confirm the actual mail provider before changing them.
manual_review.caching: Respect origin cache headers. Do not cache authenticated HTML, contact information, or private responses. Fingerprinted public assets may be cached when the host supports it.
manual_review.waf: Review existing managed rules and security events. Avoid broad blocking or challenges without evidence of abuse.
manual_review.redirects: Canonical .com and www routing require active host certificates and a verified host-aware redirect mechanism. Separate Insights and Systems deployments remain planned.
manual_review.layneip.tech: Inventory and preserve existing use and mail. The four Sites bindings now include both tech hostnames; review conflicts before adding their website records. Redirect to the com canonical origin only after both hostnames and certificates work.
manual_review.account: Verify MFA, recovery methods, least-privilege tokens, registrar lock, renewal settings and certificate/expiry alerts in the authenticated dashboard. No billing or account changes are automated.
